description: Western Province - The Western Provincial Finance (Amendment) Statute No. 01 of 2016
reasoning: This gazette content primarily concerns the enactment of the Financial (Amendment) Statute No. 01 of 2016 for the Western Province Provincial Council. It involves legal amendments to an existing statute (Western Provincial Finance Statute No. 06 of 1990), specifies regulatory changes to revenue collection procedures, and establishes a Revenue Incentive Fund with detailed regulatory provisions. While it mentions the Chief Minister's name and titles, the core content is legislative/regulatory in nature, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette rather than a government personnel or hybrid classification.
